articles.summary: What happens after you fund care for a patient on Watsi? Years later, your impact is still unfolding. Meet Elias and Yonase from Ethiopia—once patients, now students and dreamers—thanks to our community of supporters.
articles.title: Forever impact starts here

articles.summary: When a group of Ryans came together to help a little boy named Ryan on Watsi, ABC News took notice. This heartwarming story shows how a shared name—and a shared sense of humanity—can forever change a life. Watch the clip and see what generosity in action looks like.
articles.title: Watsi on ABC News!
